Elaine: quick heads-up — hitting 404s in runtime examples when running the curl snippets :grimacing:
Sam: ouch. which files? paste the codeblocks please
Elaine: /docs/runtime/quickstart.md and /docs/runtime/examples/streaming.md
Elaine: broken curl examples:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/legacy-model/generate
curl https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/examples/runtime/legacy-stream.json
```
Jordan: got it, i can change the endpoints to the v2 paths and update codeblocks
Toni: looks like the second curl is a CDN-hosted json; i'll check bucket ACLs and rehost if needed
Sam: can we also add a doc_steward frontmatter key? small metadata update would help ownership
Elaine: yeah, who owns runtime docs for the sprint? @Jordan? @Sam?
Jordan: i'll take doc stewardship for runtime this sprint. i'll bundle frontmatter + fixes in one PR
Toni: cool — i'll upload the file to the docs CDN and post the new path here when done
Sam: tiny request: change example response field `token_count` -> `tokens_used` (API changed last month)
Jordan: will swap the field and add a short inline note "response fields changed 2026-02-10"
docs-bot: link-scanner: found 3 stale/redirecting links under /docs/runtime — report: https://internal/reports/linkscan/1825554321
Elaine: thanks bot. @Toni can you take the image rehost (assets/img/runtime/latency-diagram.png)? @Jordan will do the two snippet edits
Toni: taking image, rehost in progress. will paste new CDN URL shortly
Jordan: draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/900 — fixes examples, adds doc_steward frontmatter, updates response field
Sam: reviewing now. one wording nit on batching thresholds and a small code formatting tweak
Elaine: left two inline suggestions and added a concise changelog blurb in the PR description
Jordan: pushed updates addressing comments. CI queued
docs-bot: CI: docs build passed for PR #900
Sam: LGTM. merging after CI green
Toni: rehost complete — updated CDN path in the PR
Sam: merged. thanks y'all. can we add a brief note in the runtime guide about "example URL churn" so ppl know to ping the doc_steward when examples move? 1-2 lines
Jordan: added the note and left a changelog entry in /docs/CHANGELOG.md — "runtime: fixed example endpoints, rehosted assets, updated response fields"
Elaine: nice quick turnaround. thanks team :tada:
